g.text: US102 — Detect Aircraft Safety Violations in Real Time
unblocked — run physics step in parallel
Children are blocked on step semaphores here —
shared memory is safe to read without extra locking.
1. write() "[callsign] SIGTERM: simulation terminated. Cleaning up."
2. g_terminate = 1 (async-signal-safe flag — no exit() in handler)
